origin.description: Triple integral as a double integral of an inner integral in x.
origin.usage: triplequad(f, xa, xb, ya, yb, za, zb, subdivs = 300, tol = .Machine$double.eps^0.5, ...)

arguments.name: f
arguments.text: Integrand of x, y, and z.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Tolerance for the outer double integral.

origin.details: y sin(x) + z cos(x) on [0, pi] x [0, 1] x [-1, 1]
origin.value: Triple integral as a double integral of an inner integral in x.
origin.example: print(triplequad(function(x, y, z) y*sin(x) + z*cos(x), 0, pi, 0, 1, -1, 1))
